en.topic_title: Former Hong Kong prison guard jailed for 3 years over attack on inmate
en.topic_summary:
A former Hong Kong corrections officer who wounded an inmate by repeatedly thrusting a stick into his rectum has been jailed for three years.



Pik Uk Correctional Institution. File photo: Wikimedia Commons.



Tam Lik-chung, a former Correctional Services Department assistant officer, was handed the jail term after District Court Judge Frankie Yiu ruled the former prison guard had ordered other inmates to take part in the December 2023 attack.



Tam was also charged with perverting the course
